key_findings: Velutin suppressed IL-1β-induced inflammatory mediators and ECM-degrading enzymes (MMP3, MMP13, ADAMTS5) in nucleus pulposus cells and restored collagen II.
Velutin blocked IκBα/p65, JNK and ERK activation and reduced histological scores and COX-2 in a mouse IVDD model.
